scope: Configurable native LaTeX, one original article in four language pairs, independently installable skills, and semantic learning examples. Not universal language, printer or accessibility certification.

cases.expected_error: Column gap must not be negative
Can be used only in preamble

page_and_language_review.limits: Visual and author-level review, not external human translation or printer certification.

realistic_usage.workflow: Original teaching source to independently authored notes and keyword/concept Quick
Independent native starter authoring and separate structured authoring of a supplied article with a shared photo and continuous long paragraph
realistic_usage.minor_hurdle: Removed the documented optional native running title to match the structured presentation.

legacy_cjk_compatibility.cause: Polyglossia before 2.3 lacks the Chinese/Japanese automatic line-breaking hooks.
legacy_cjk_compatibility.actual_old_distribution_validation: Use the exact-commit Ubuntu 24.04 Actions result; local simulation is not old-distribution certification.

unverified: Other language combinations and traditional Chinese
Vertical writing and unrestricted font fallback
notes: Expected compile/QA failures are not counted as usable PDFs.
No overflow or missing glyph is accepted in positive cases.
Native and structured pixel comparisons use the same restored official TeX toolchain; cross-platform byte identity is not claimed.
Native TeX remains executable; no-shell-escape is not a filesystem sandbox.
CI status belongs to the exact remote commit and is not asserted by this local record.
Default appearance is regression-checked; custom profiles intentionally change pagination.
